primary_heldout.split: A5-frozen deterministic official validation slice, 5000 frames

excluded_before_heldout.name: sharpen
reason: not better than current_adaptive_cached on recovered GT per extra call
not better than current_adaptive_cached on FP cost per recovered GT
larger center and size jitter regressions than current_adaptive_cached
its small measured incremental-ms-per-recovery advantage is not enough to establish a convincing quality-per-compute advantage from one development run

final_decision_rule: If neither strict bilateral nor strict current_adaptive_cached shows a convincing post-fusion quality-per-compute and stability gain over OFF on the frozen held-out evidence, hand off ENHANCEMENT OFF.

candidate_must: satisfy selective_gate=weak-person, max_enhanced_rois_per_source_frame=1, and raw corroboration
have post-fusion recall strictly greater than OFF
have post-fusion F1 strictly greater than OFF
have post-fusion precision not lower than OFF
have bbox localization IoU not lower than OFF
not regress core bbox stability: center/width/height jitter must not increase and temporal IoU must not decrease when measurable
show positive recovered-GT per extra enhancement call with all incremental compute explicitly reported
final_decision_gate.tie_policy: If both enhancement candidates clear the gate but neither gives a clear multidimensional quality+stability+compute dominance, retain OFF rather than choose from one metric.
